headline: Prime ESE angle and chest-high sets — get the dawn before the SW fills in.
today: Best swell direction this spot gets, 1.5 to 2.4ft pushing 3ft on the sets at a fun period. Trouble is the SW cross-on is already up at dawn and grinds all day into an onshore evening, so this is a dawn patrol call — the WSW is barely cross early and it cleans up around the incoming tide. Shortboard or groveler while it has size and shape; don't sleep in.

daysToWatch.note: Smaller at 1.2 to 1.5ft but clean WNW cross-off all day. Loggable dawn-to-dusk if you want a mellow one.
Flat. Under a foot and howling N offshore over nothing. Skip it.
Afternoon goes glassy light with a bit of E swell around. Small but fun on the log if you're local.
